craft_notes: Sthāyin: Seal of completion (samādhi). Kept (blink held, feat questioned). Rejected: 'beyond' for 'past' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: For but a blink, with faults outworn, to lodge thy tread in heart —
then what, Śambhu, past thy doing?
l4.sanskrit_cite: nimeṣam api yady ekaṃ kṣīṇadoṣe kariṣyasi padaṃ citte tadā śambho kiṃ na sampādayiṣyasi

reads_against.argmap: Even one wink, if fault-waned you make foot in mind. → One faultless wink of mind-foot accomplishes all.
reads_against.l2: Grant one blinking's room with faults outworn to lodge within the breast — then, Śambhu, what feat past your doing?
l3: For but a blink, with faults outworn, lodge thy tread in heart —
then what, Śambhu, beyond thy compass?
reads_against.t1: Even one wink, if fault-waned you make foot in mind — then, O Śambhu, what will you not accomplish?
